synthesis.procedure: Solutions of [Sm(dmso)4(NO3)3] (120 mg) in dmf (5 mL) and of (LH4·CHCl3) (25 mg) and NEt3 (0.15 mL) in dmf (1 mL) were mixed in a capped vial. Colourless plates deposited over 4 d, were washed with diethyl ether and air-dried. Yield 13 mg. Bulk microanalysis indicated partial desolvation/hydration relative to the crystal (formulated as Sm2(LH)2·7dmf·5H2O).
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colourless plates from the reaction mixture; washed with diethyl ether and air-dried.

synthesis.procedure: A solution of (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6] (74 mg) in dmf (1 mL), prepared as quickly as possible, was added immediately to (LH4·CHCl3) (100 mg) and NEt3 (0.15 mL) in dmf (1 mL). The initially intense violet colour faded and, after 24 h, colourless crystals mixed with a few violet crystals deposited. Colourless crystals were washed with MeCN. Yield 73 mg. The product is Ce(III); the same material was also obtained using [Ce(dmso)4(NO3)3] in place of ceric ammonium nitrate. Satisfactory bulk analyses were not obtained.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colourless crystals separated from a minor violet fraction and washed with acetonitrile.

properties.summary: The colourless product is described as paramagnetic and therefore Ce(III), but no susceptibility or other magnetic data are reported.

synthesis.procedure: Hot (90 °C) solutions of [Sm(dmso)4(NO3)3] (350 mg) in dmso (2 mL) and of (LH4·CHCl3) (200 mg) and NEt3 (0.1 mL) in dmso (2 mL) were mixed rapidly and cooled. A white precipitate formed immediately and was collected after 24 h, washed with MeCN then ether, and air-dried. Yield 217 mg. Crude analysis was fitted to Sm3O(LH)2(NO3)·3dmso. Crystals: crude material (5 mg) in hot (60 °C) pyridine (0.1 mL) with vapour diffusion of MeCN (2 mL) gave very pale yellow tablets over several days.
synthesis.temperature: 90 °C mixing, then room temperature; recrystallization at 60 °C
synthesis.time: 24 h precipitation; crystals over several days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: rapid mixing then MeCN vapour diffusion into pyridine
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crude solid washed with MeCN and ether; recrystallized from hot pyridine by MeCN vapour diffusion.

synthesis.procedure: Hot (90 °C) solutions of [Eu(dmso)4(NO3)3] (350 mg) in dmso (2 mL) and of (LH4·CHCl3) (200 mg) and NEt3 (0.1 mL) in dmso (2 mL) were mixed rapidly. A yellow precipitate formed almost immediately and was collected after 24 h, washed with MeCN then ether, and air-dried. Yield 255 mg. Crude analysis fitted Eu3O(LH)2(NO3)·2dmso. Crystals from crude material (5 mg) in hot (60 °C) pyridine (0.1 mL) by vapour diffusion of MeCN (2 mL); yellow tablets over several days.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: rapid mixing; MeCN vapour diffusion into pyridine
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow precipitate washed with MeCN and ether; recrystallized as yellow tablets.

synthesis.procedure: Starting from [Dy(dmso)3(NO3)3], the procedure identical to that for 6Eu was used: hot dmso reaction of the nitrate solvate with (LH4·CHCl3) and NEt3, isolation of the precipitate, then recrystallization from hot pyridine by MeCN vapour diffusion, giving near-colourless crystals. Amounts are those stated for 6Eu (350 mg metal salt, 200 mg ligand, 0.1 mL NEt3, 2 mL + 2 mL dmso).
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Near-colourless crystals from pyridine/MeCN vapour diffusion.

synthesis.procedure: An identical procedure to that for the Sm, Eu and Dy analogues gave colourless crystals. Crude material isolated directly from dmso analysed differently from the Sm and Eu crudes, as Lu3O(L)(LH)(NO3)2·2dmso, although the recrystallized crystals share the 6Ln stoichiometry.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colourless crystals after pyridine/MeCN recrystallization.

synthesis.procedure: (LH4·CHCl3) (0.3 g) was dissolved in dmf (3 mL) containing NEt3 (0.45 mL) and a solution of [Gd(dmso)4(NO3)3] (0.32 g) in dmf (1.55 mL) was added quickly. The white precipitate (0.0647 g) was filtered off and the filtrate kept in a freezer for several months, giving a second fraction (0.0459 g; total yield 31.1%). Single crystals were grown from CH2Cl2/MeOH. Bulk analysis fitted Gd4O2L4·2H2O·2MeOH·dmf·3.375CH2Cl2.
